text: おまえさん　ずいぶん　べんきょう　したんやなあ

structure.jp: ずいぶん　べんきょう　したんやなあ
structure.en: have really studied a lot, haven't you

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ shows the speaker has just realised or understood something; んや is the Kansai dialect form, and なあ adds admiration. べんきょう したんやなあ = 'so you've studied, haven't you'.
